requirements.title: BIND module variables and Fortran common blocks have program-long C linkage association
requirements.definition: Linkage association occurs between a BIND module variable and the interoperating C variable, or between a Fortran common block and the interoperating C variable, and remains in effect throughout program execution.

pending.bind-module-variable-c-linkage: Cross-reference main owner doc/catalogues/c_global_variables_general_18_9_1.json S18.9.1-001/S18.9.1-002 and label owner doc/catalogues/binding_labels_common_blocks_variables_18_9_2.json S18.9.2-006: future mixed Fortran/C plan exposes a BIND(C) module integer initialized to 1, C writes 42 to the matching external-linkage variable, and Fortran reads exact 42.
pending.common-block-c-linkage: Cross-reference main owner doc/catalogues/c_global_variables_general_18_9_1.json S18.9.1-005 through S18.9.1-007 and doc/catalogues/binding_labels_common_blocks_variables_18_9_2.json S18.9.2-006: future mixed Fortran/C plan binds a named common block with integer x=1, C writes 42 through the matching C variable or structure member, and Fortran reads exact 42.
pending.linkage-association-program-long: Cross-reference main owner doc/catalogues/c_global_variables_general_18_9_1.json S18.9.1-* and doc/catalogues/binding_labels_common_blocks_variables_18_9_2.json S18.9.2-006: future plan performs two C calls separated by unrelated Fortran work, writing 42 then 77 to the same matched object, and Fortran observes both exact values through the same linkage association.

requirements.oracle: Source registration only. Future fixtures establish a distinguished non-default state first, then observe only portable single-image properties: exact integer, logical, character, type, rank, bounds, ASSOCIATED inquiry results for defined pointer association status, or required syntax diagnostics owned by a numbered rule. Undefined pointer association status and undefined definition status are never inspected, dereferenced, invoked, compared, or passed to ASSOCIATED as an oracle.
requirements.oracle_limitation: This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Unnumbered program restrictions are source-control restrictions only. Notes are informative. Coarray, image, team, companion-processor lifetime, volatile-interference, addresses, diagnostic wording, exit status details, and processor-dependent representations are not asserted.
requirements.dependencies: Existing owner catalogues on main for C global variables are doc/catalogues/c_global_variables_general_18_9_1.json (S18.9.1-001 through S18.9.1-008) and doc/catalogues/binding_labels_common_blocks_variables_18_9_2.json (especially S18.9.2-006 for matching Fortran and C variable labels establishing linkage association). This 19.5.1.5 catalogue records the name-association consequence and keeps concrete mixed Fortran/C sentinel plans aligned with those owners.

review_rationale: Source registration for 19.5 through 19.5.2.7: name association (argument, use, host, linkage and construct association) and pointer association (batch252). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; each localizing context has a discriminating wrong-resolution sentinel and construct association is checked in both directions. Source accounting only.
